Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
8:31 PM

Here is a relaxed 3 day Jaipur plan for your parents, with a slow morning start and a long rest after lunch.

Day 1: Old city

Morning: Hawa Mahal from outside, then City Palace and Jantar Mantar
Afternoon: Lunch and rest
Evening: Johari Bazaar for a gentle stroll and shopping, then dinner at a rooftop spot

Day 2: Forts

Morning: Amer Fort (go early to avoid heat and crowds; the jeep ride up is easier than the walk)
Midday: Panna Meena ka Kund and Jal Mahal photo stop on the way back
Evening: Rest, then Chokhi Dhani for a village-style dinner and folk show

Day 3: Easy day

Morning: Albert Hall Museum and Birla Mandir
Afternoon: Lunch, then Nahargarh Fort for the sunset view
Evening: Pack up and enjoy a last lassi

Tips: November is a pleasant time to visit. A hired car for the day saves your parents a lot of walking, and the Jaipur sights are close to each other. Entry fees and timings may have changed, so check them before you go.
